facts.text: Wilmington University offers seven-week block classes, running two blocks per semester with courses meeting once per week for five hours.

sources.title: Course Schedule and Format Options - Wilmington University
sources.quote: Block classes are seven weeks long and are accelerated versions of semester classes. Typically, each face-to-face or online-live block class meets once per week for five hours. There are two seven-week blocks during each semester.
